nodes.label: Adding a New Tab
nodes.rationale: A documented recipe so the 9-tab shell stays consistent as tabs are added.

nodes.label: Component Structure
nodes.rationale: matlit components grouped per tab under src/components/matlit, with a documented convention for adding a new tab.

nodes.label: App Logo (public/logo.svg)
nodes.rationale: Small vector logo asset used as the brand mark in the header and as the favicon source.

nodes.label: Next.js Favicon (src/app/icon.svg)
nodes.rationale: Next.js App Router icon route asset that the framework serves as the browser tab favicon.

nodes.label: Command Palette
nodes.rationale: Cmd+K palette searching materials, tabs, and actions.

nodes.label: Keyboard Shortcuts
nodes.rationale: 1-9 switches tabs, L toggles language, T toggles theme.

nodes.label: Multi-Config LLM Backend
nodes.rationale: Z.ai as the default free backend plus any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, Azure, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM). Configs are saved and switchable per request from the Settings dialog.

nodes.label: Settings Dialog
nodes.rationale: All user configuration (literature API keys, LLM provider, base URL, model) lives in the Settings gear. Keys are stored in browser localStorage and sent per-request via headers - never on the server or in .env.

nodes.label: Activity Timeline
nodes.rationale: Dashboard activity timeline, later with type filtering, then a 90-day activity heatmap.

nodes.label: History Trend
nodes.rationale: Stats history endpoint backing trend views over time.

nodes.label: AI Literature Review
nodes.rationale: Generates a synthesis across a material's collected papers.

nodes.label: Paper Chat
nodes.rationale: A chat endpoint and drawer UI for conversing with a single paper's content.

nodes.label: Device Structure Viewer
nodes.rationale: A ~440-line component rendering solar-cell device structure layers for a material.

nodes.label: Formula Visualization
nodes.rationale: Chemical formula rendering per material.

nodes.label: Import Efficiency from Extraction
nodes.rationale: Extracted efficiency values can be promoted into the efficiency database, collapsing two manual steps.

nodes.label: Manual Result Editing
nodes.rationale: Classification and extraction outputs can be edited by hand, closing the loop when the LLM is wrong.

nodes.label: Materials CSV Import/Export
nodes.rationale: CSV import with template, then drag-and-drop file upload on top.

nodes.label: Similar Material Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Recommends related materials plus a recommendation endpoint.

nodes.label: Pagination
nodes.rationale: Server-side pagination added where result sets grew too large to render whole.

nodes.label: Virtual Scrolling
nodes.rationale: Papers table virtualized with react-virtual for large result sets.

nodes.label: Browser Notifications
nodes.rationale: Desktop alert when a long batch operation completes.

nodes.label: Per-Tab Error Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Each tab is wrapped so one failing panel cannot take down the app shell.

nodes.label: 60 Default Materials
nodes.rationale: A curated seed set of perovskite, chalcogenide, and oxide materials loaded by one click.

nodes.label: Drag-Reorder Tabs
nodes.rationale: Users reorder the 9 tabs themselves; the order is persisted.

nodes.label: Theme System
nodes.rationale: Light, dark, and system theme via next-themes, persisted.

nodes.label: Advanced Filters
nodes.rationale: Classification filters plus extraction confidence filter and feature toggles; filter chips later gained counts.

nodes.label: API Key Configuration
nodes.rationale: The first implementation did not actually take effect and had to be fixed as a high-priority bug - a reminder that settings UIs are easy to fake.

nodes.label: BibTeX Export
nodes.rationale: BibTeX export added, then made filterable from the Results tab and command palette.

nodes.label: Citation Network Graph
nodes.rationale: D3 force-directed graph, enhanced later with filters and top-citations.

nodes.label: Citation Ranking
nodes.rationale: Top-citations ranking view over the collected papers.

nodes.label: Command Palette (Cmd+K)
nodes.rationale: Global Cmd+K palette, later extended with Export and Settings groups and recents.

nodes.label: Coverage Matrix
nodes.rationale: Built early and repeatedly enhanced: clickable-to-jump cards, multi-target jump, hover tooltips, then search and filter. Flagged 'high value' in the worklog.

nodes.label: Dark-Mode Chart Adaptation
nodes.rationale: Recharts needed several passes - series colors, legend, then axis line colors - because charts are the main thing that breaks under a theme switch.

nodes.label: Docker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage Dockerfile with standalone output and a compose file bundling the mini-services.

nodes.label: DOI Auto-Detection
nodes.rationale: DOIs are auto-detected from text, with a later batch validation endpoint.

nodes.label: React Error Boundary
nodes.rationale: Per-tab error boundaries so a crashing panel degrades locally.

nodes.label: Excel Export
nodes.rationale: xlsx export added after CSV/JSON/BibTeX.

nodes.label: Markdown Export
nodes.rationale: A ~430-line Markdown export route alongside the existing formats.

nodes.label: PDF Report Export
nodes.rationale: Dashboard can export a PDF report; exports later gained an evidence-source column and a Markdown renderer.

nodes.label: Favorites Store
nodes.rationale: Client-side favorites for materials with filtering in the Materials tab.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph API + Component
nodes.rationale: A /api/knowledge-graph route, a dedicated component, and Dashboard integration.

nodes.label: LLM Service
nodes.rationale: src/lib/llm.ts wrapping z-ai-web-dev-sdk with classifyAbstract, extractData, batch helpers, and retry with backoff for 429s.

nodes.label: Material Compare + Radar
nodes.rationale: Side-by-side comparison table, then a radar chart with keyboard-accessible tooltips, then a compare report endpoint.

nodes.label: Mobile Responsive Audit
nodes.rationale: Responsive audit covering tables, the Results card layout, and a mobile card view for classification rows.

nodes.label: One-Click Pipeline
nodes.rationale: A single button runs the whole search-classify-extract chain, with next-step suggestion cards and smart material-search expansion.

nodes.label: Papers Detail Drawer
nodes.rationale: Paper drawer with reclassify/extract actions; a later pass wired the buttons that were originally rendered but inert.

nodes.label: PDF Reader + Image Proxy
nodes.rationale: In-app PDF reading with a proxy route to avoid hotlink and CORS failures on external PDFs.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Support
nodes.rationale: Provider switch documented and supported so the same schema runs on SQLite or Postgres.

nodes.label: Save Search Presets
nodes.rationale: Search presets can be saved, loaded, and deleted; a recent-searches history was also added.

nodes.label: Orchestrator + Subagent Groups
nodes.rationale: Feature batches are split into groups (Task 30-A/B/C/D) and dispatched to subagents, with the orchestrator fixing cross-cutting fallout and re-verifying. Parallelism is the main throughput lever for a solo project.

nodes.label: Drag-Reorder Tabs
nodes.rationale: Tabs are user-reorderable with a persisted custom order.

nodes.label: VLM Phase-Diagram Recognition
nodes.rationale: Started as single-image recognition, then auto-extracts figures from OA papers, then batch analysis.

nodes.label: REST API Conventions
nodes.rationale: REST conventions plus a shared apiError helper so every route fails the same way.

nodes.label: Zod Validation
nodes.rationale: Every route validates input with Zod; these same schemas drive the in-app API docs.

nodes.label: Compose App Service
nodes.rationale: Builds the repo, exposes 3000, points DATABASE_URL at /app/db/custom.db, sets REALTIME_HTTP_URL=http://realtime-service:3005, mounts a named db-data volume, and depends_on realtime-service.

nodes.label: db-data Named Volume
nodes.rationale: Persists the SQLite database across container rebuilds.

nodes.label: Compose Realtime Service
nodes.rationale: Builds mini-services/realtime-service on ports 3004 (socket) and 3005 (HTTP emit/health).

nodes.label: In-App API Docs
nodes.rationale: Interactive docs at /docs rendered from the same Zod schemas that validate the routes, so documentation and validation cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Credentials Auth
nodes.rationale: NextAuth.js v4 with a real /auth/signin page, /api/auth/[...nextauth], and /api/auth/register backed by bcryptjs and the User/Account models.

nodes.label: Source Circuit Breakers
nodes.rationale: Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and CrossRef each carry a breaker that opens for 30s after 5 failures, with exponential backoff and Retry-After respect.

nodes.label: Citation Network Graph
nodes.rationale: D3.js force-directed graph with classification and citation filters plus zoom.

nodes.label: Classification Tab
nodes.rationale: LLM batch classify at temp=0, confidence slider, feature toggles for bandgap/method/efficiency/phase diagram, evidence quotes.

nodes.label: Confidence Scoring
nodes.rationale: 0-1 confidence per classification; low-confidence results are surfaced for human review rather than silently accepted.

nodes.label: Coverage Matrix Heatmap
nodes.rationale: 5-dimension heatmap of extraction coverage across materials; click to jump to the relevant tab, hover tooltip.

nodes.label: Dashboard Tab
nodes.rationale: Stat cards with progress rings, workflow steps, coverage matrix heatmap, activity timeline, efficiency trend, papers timeline, batch progress.

nodes.label: DOI + Jaccard Dedup
nodes.rationale: Deduplication by exact DOI match plus Jaccard title similarity at a 0.85 threshold, because the same paper is returned by several repositories at once.

nodes.label: Docker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage Dockerfile with standalone output plus a compose file bundling the app and both mini-services - the progress service on 3003 and the realtime relay on 3004/3005. SQLite is the zero-config default.

nodes.label: Efficiency Tab
nodes.rationale: Aggregated stat cards (max/avg/certified/count), horizontal bar chart, manual entry and delete.

nodes.label: Export Formats
nodes.rationale: CSV, JSON, BibTeX, and Excel exports, filterable, from the Results tab.

nodes.label: Extraction Tab
nodes.rationale: LLM deep extraction of bandgap value, synthesis method, conditions, phase diagram, efficiency.

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Material-paper-extraction relationship graph.

nodes.label: Material Compare
nodes.rationale: Side-by-side comparison table plus radar chart.

nodes.label: Materials Tab
nodes.rationale: 60 default materials plus CRUD, CSV import (drag/paste/template), CSV export, category color borders, search and filter.

nodes.label: MatLit Miner
nodes.rationale: AI-assisted literature mining web app for materials science (solar cell / perovskite focus). Digitizes material list -> multi-source search -> LLM classification -> deep extraction -> efficiency DB -> human verification -> DOI-linked export. Every cell traceable to a DOI; every LLM call temp=0.

nodes.label: Multi-Key Failover
nodes.rationale: Multiple API keys per source are tried in priority order, and source-level fallback retries the next repository in the chain S2 -> CrossRef -> OpenAlex -> arXiv -> EuropePMC.

nodes.label: Papers Tab
nodes.rationale: 5-source parallel search, dedup by DOI and Jaccard, card/table toggle, bulk ops, paper drawer, OA PDF via Unpaywall.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Migration Path
nodes.rationale: Two-step documented path: flip DATABASE_URL and change the provider in schema.prisma, then db:push. Single-user dev on SQLite, multi-user on Postgres.

nodes.label: 8 Prisma Models
nodes.rationale: User, Account, Material, Paper, Classification, Efficiency, Verification, ExtractionJob. The earlier '6 models' count predated the User and Account models added for credentials-based NextAuth.

nodes.label: Project Structure
nodes.rationale: Next.js app with 98 REST routes, 43 matlit components across 4 sub-folders, and a 44-module src/lib layer of one module per literature API plus shared resilience, store, and prediction helpers.

nodes.label: Results Tab
nodes.rationale: Summary table with sticky first column and expandable evidence rows, mobile card layout, CSV/BibTeX/JSON/Excel export.

nodes.label: 98 REST Routes
nodes.rationale: The app exposes 98 Next.js route handlers. Beyond the core CRUD and batch surface documented in the endpoint table, 63 further routes cover per-record deep dives, an AI research layer, collaboration, analytics, and realtime plumbing. The README now lists them grouped by area.

nodes.label: Sources Tab
nodes.rationale: 8 data-source cards, API health check with 60s cache and latency, VLM phase-diagram recognition, D3 citation network, material compare.

nodes.label: Unpaywall OA Enrichment
nodes.rationale: Legal open-access full-text links with gold/green/hybrid/bronze/closed status, used to make full-text and VLM figure extraction possible at all.

nodes.label: Verification Tab
nodes.rationale: Batch verify with Verify all / Flag all, quick stats, project isolation and reviewer identity.

nodes.label: VLM Phase-Diagram Recognition
nodes.rationale: Single image or batch auto-scan of open-access paper figures to read phase diagrams.

nodes.label: Benchmarks Module
nodes.rationale: A src/lib/benchmarks.ts module surfaced in the Results tab.

nodes.label: Job Store + Header Indicator
nodes.rationale: A server-side job store with a header progress indicator and RunDialog wiring; downstream work reused the store.

nodes.label: Material Tags
nodes.rationale: Flexible semicolon-separated grouping beyond the fixed perovskite/oxide/chalcogenide categories.

nodes.label: Multilingual Paper Translation
nodes.rationale: Non-English titles and abstracts are detected (ISO 639-1) and LLM-translated to English, with batch translation.

nodes.label: Paper Notes
nodes.rationale: Per-paper user notes and annotations persisted on the Paper model.

nodes.label: Efficiency Prediction API
nodes.rationale: A /api/predict/efficiency route plus a Dashboard prediction card; a bandgap predictor was added alongside.

nodes.label: Prisma Schema (6 Models)
nodes.rationale: Material, Paper, Classification, Efficiency, Verification, ExtractionJob with indexes on materialId, status, doi, year. Semicolon-separated strings are used for list fields because SQLite cannot do relational arrays.

nodes.label: Realtime Service + Relay
nodes.rationale: A second mini-service plus an /api/realtime/emit relay and a use-realtime hook, replacing ad-hoc progress plumbing.

nodes.label: RunDialog Countdown
nodes.rationale: Dynamic countdown in the run dialog so batch waits are visible rather than open-ended.

nodes.label: WebSocket Batch Progress
nodes.rationale: Live progress for batch operations, then refined for finer-grained updates because the first version was too coarse.

nodes.label: Shared Zod Schemas
nodes.rationale: A single src/lib/schemas.ts (~210 lines) adopted by 6 routes so validation and the in-app /docs cannot drift.

nodes.label: DOI Traceability
nodes.rationale: Every result links to a DOI and papers without one are flagged. Makes the final table citable.

nodes.label: Evidence Quotes
nodes.rationale: Every extracted value ships with a supporting quote from the abstract so a human can audit it. This is the core anti-hallucination lever.

nodes.label: temperature=0 Discipline
nodes.rationale: Every LLM call runs at temperature 0. The stated rationale is 'no hallucination temperature' - determinism is treated as a data-quality requirement, not a convenience.

nodes.label: Circuit-Breaker Status Badge
nodes.rationale: Surfaces live breaker state for CrossRef and the other guarded sources in the UI.

nodes.label: Configurable Dedup Strategy
nodes.rationale: The dedup policy became user-configurable after the P0 fix that made cross-source dedup actually fire.

nodes.label: Material Provenance
nodes.rationale: A per-material provenance endpoint feeding a Results-tab view.

nodes.label: 5-Source Parallel Search
nodes.rationale: Search expanded from 2 to 5 repositories (Semantic Scholar, CrossRef, OpenAlex, arXiv, Europe PMC) plus Unpaywall enrichment. /api/papers/search queries all of them in parallel and merges.

nodes.label: P0 Data-Quality Fixes
nodes.rationale: HTML entities leaking into paper titles, cross-source dedup not actually firing, and a misleading Extraction tab title - all fixed in one prioritized pass.

nodes.label: RRI-Style Multi-Source Provenance
nodes.rationale: altSources tracks every repository that returned the same paper. The rationale is that convergence across independent sources is itself a signal of reliability, so provenance is stored rather than discarded.

nodes.label: S2 429 -> CrossRef Fallback
nodes.rationale: Semantic Scholar returned 429s in the sandbox, which forced CrossRef into existence as a real fallback rather than a nice-to-have. Every resilience feature in this project has an incident that created it.

nodes.label: CI Build Job
nodes.rationale: Runs after lint (needs: lint): bun install, db:generate, then bun run build.

nodes.label: CI Lint Job
nodes.rationale: bun install then bun run lint on ubuntu-latest, using oven-sh/setup-bun.

nodes.label: ESLint Config
nodes.rationale: ESLint with Next.js rules plus custom rules; lint is the first CI gate.

nodes.label: PR Process
nodes.rationale: A checklist plus review criteria and post-merge steps.

nodes.label: TypeScript Strict Mode
nodes.rationale: Strict TS is a hard rule for contributors; the repo also sets ignoreBuildErrors in next.config.ts, so type errors are lint-time concerns rather than build gates.

nodes.label: CI/CD
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions with a lint job gating a build job.

nodes.label: i18n Patterns
nodes.rationale: Two sanctioned patterns - the t() helper with provider keys (preferred) and inline locale checks for one-offs - plus explicit rules.

nodes.label: Accessibility
nodes.rationale: ARIA roles, focus-visible, skip-link, and reduced-motion support.

nodes.label: i18n zh/en System
nodes.rationale: Chinese and English with one-click switch and browser auto-detect, backed by roughly 1,600 translation keys in a single i18n provider dictionary file.

nodes.label: Accessibility Audit
nodes.rationale: A dedicated pass: noisy tablist aria-labels, unlabeled PDF button, aria-label on the confidence slider, reduced-motion.

nodes.label: i18n Wiring Sweep
nodes.rationale: All 8 tab components were converted to useI18n with labelKey arrays replacing hardcoded label strings. Toasts were deliberately left English, and strings lacking exact dictionary keys were left untranslated and reported.

nodes.label: No Test Runner
nodes.rationale: The repo ships three build/runtime smoke shell scripts and no test framework; CONTRIBUTING formalizes agent-browser manual testing as the acceptance gate instead.

nodes.label: Manual Testing via agent-browser
nodes.rationale: There is no test runner in the repo; CONTRIBUTING formalizes agent-browser manual testing and what to check in dev.log. Tests/ holds three shell scripts, not unit tests.

nodes.label: Agent-Browser E2E Verification
nodes.rationale: Every stage is verified by driving a real browser - seed, search, classify, extract, efficiency, verify, results, export. The worklog treats this as the acceptance gate, not a lint pass.

nodes.label: Cron Review Loop
nodes.rationale: A 15-minute cron triggers QA-then-feature rounds, so the project improves continuously without a human pushing each cycle. This is the mechanism behind the long tail of small UX and a11y fixes.

nodes.label: VLM Visual Review
nodes.rationale: Screenshots are reviewed by a vision model for layout and visual quality, and the results directly drive follow-up styling work - for example Results got a mobile card layout and dark-mode charts were reworked because of VLM feedback.

nodes.label: Collaboration Features
nodes.rationale: Verification assignment, reviewer notes, project isolation, team workspace, and material share cards.

nodes.label: Team Workspace
nodes.rationale: Client-side workspace store with share cards and a notification popover.

nodes.label: Verification Assignment + Notes
nodes.rationale: Assignment and notes endpoints backing the collaboration tab, plus a material-list indicator.

nodes.label: Verify Auto-Fill
nodes.rationale: Verification form prefill plus an auto-update endpoint so status stays honest as data changes.

nodes.label: Compose Progress Service
nodes.rationale: Builds mini-services/progress-service on port 3003.

nodes.label: Batch Cancellation
nodes.rationale: Long-running classify and extract jobs can be cancelled mid-stream.

nodes.label: WebSocket Batch Progress
nodes.rationale: Batch operations stream live progress over Socket.io from a separate progress service on port 3003. The app degrades gracefully to REST polling without it.

nodes.label: API Caching
nodes.rationale: Lazy plus periodic 5-minute eviction for caches; source health checks cached 60s.

nodes.label: Data Backup/Restore
nodes.rationale: Full DB backup to JSON and restore, plus a cache-clear endpoint.

nodes.label: Payload Reduction
nodes.rationale: Repeated passes trimmed response sizes and introduced pagination and virtual scrolling. The rationale is that the SQLite-backed app still has to move JSON through the browser.
